senses.gloss: m. (פְּנֵי; sub. דרמשא or דשמשא) afternoon, sunset, evening; first part of the night.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 7:16">Targ. Y. Lev. VII, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 6:7">Targ. Y. Deut. VI, 7</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 49a:16">B. Mets. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>אפ׳ דמעלי שבתא הוה</he> it was on a Friday towards evening.
<cite ref="Yoma 14b:1">Yoma 14ᵇ</cite> <he>ולפ׳ מדו ליה</he> and towards evening they sprinkle upon him; <cite ref="Yoma 19a:10">ib. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>לבהדי פ׳</he>, <he>להדי פ׳</he>; a. e.
